revalidation_triggers: routing or host/path normalization changes in internal/router or internal/middleware
client-address or backend-TLS trust changes in internal/clientaddr or internal/backendtls
authentication or withdrawal gate changes in internal/auth or internal/app
cache key, Vary, or cutover changes in internal/cache
WAF connector, outcome, or exception compilation changes in internal/waf
protocol adapter changes in internal/handler, internal/server, or internal/stream

cases.scenario: Intentional-public static portal succeeds while restricted backend denies anonymous and wrong-credential requests before origin
cases.limitations: Loopback/in-process listener fixture; physical multi-host LAN tested separately in #581 F1

cases.scenario: Alternate Host header, unmatched-Host fallback, dot-segment encoded paths, rewrites, and method/header predicates cannot shadow or widen restricted routes
cases.limitations: Tests Jul HTTP router normalization and predicate dispatch

cases.scenario: Forged X-Forwarded-For, Forwarded, X-Real-IP, and client-certificate headers from untrusted peer are ignored by CIDR auth, WAF REMOTE_ADDR, and upstream forwarding
cases.limitations: Requires explicit [servers.client_address] trusted_proxies for proxy hops

cases.scenario: Backend TLS verification rejects untrusted/wrong-SAN upstream certificates while mTLS client-certificate requirement denies unverified clients on H1/H2/H3
cases.limitations: HTTP/3 mTLS parity additionally covered by internal/server:TestHTTP3ClientAuthParity

cases.scenario: Warm/cold GET/HEAD, Vary, Range, Authorization, and cookie-bypass preserve route/user isolation and never replay per-request X-Request-ID or X-Jul-WAF-Event headers
cases.limitations: Shared response cache; private/authenticated caching stays disabled or explicitly gated

cases.scenario: WAF policy tightening and route/backend cutover across reload/restart enforce new WAF rules on warm cached routes without leaking pre-cutover origin responses
cases.limitations: Requires -tags waf for real Coraza inspection before cache lookup

cases.scenario: Failed Prepare/compile reload preserves active serving generation and provenance; successful tightening, withdrawal gate, and rollback isolate unrelated routes under concurrent traffic
cases.route_scope: multi-route portal + restricted app under concurrent reload
cases.limitations: In-flight exchanges on un-narrowed routes continue to completion

cases.scenario: WebSocket upgrade handshake and SSE receive HTTP request-phase auth/WAF checks; native gRPC, transcoded gRPC, and L4 passthrough enforce their declared boundaries without false HTTP body inspection claims
cases.limitations: Opaque protobuf gRPC streams, post-101 hijacked WebSocket frames, and L4 TCP passthrough are not HTTP-body-inspected by Coraza

cases.scenario: Narrow WAF exceptions (#631) and separate blocking/detection paranoia preserve protection on neighboring fields, HTTP methods, rules, and sibling routes across reloads
cases.limitations: Requires -tags waf for Coraza pre-CRS phase:1 ctl:ruleRemoveTargetById compilation
